format_dialog.erase: Every file on the card will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
format_dialog.verify: Before erasing, the app checks that every photo and video on the card is in Immich. If anything is missing, the card is not erased.
format_dialog.outside: Files outside the photo folders (camera settings, for example) are not checked and are deleted too.

server.key_saved_placeholder: Saved — leave empty to keep it

server.invalid_url: Enter the full address, starting with http:// or https:// — for example https://immich.example.com.

logs.label: Log
settings.concurrency_hint: How many files upload at once. More can be faster on a quick network; {default} suits most cards.
settings.concurrency_auto_hint: The app finds out how many files to upload at once on your network.
settings.auto_paths_hint: Also look in the folders and file types that common cameras use, not just DCIM.
settings.autostart_hint: Start SD Sync Immich when you log in.
settings.autostart_hint_mac: Start SD Sync Immich in the menu bar when you log in.
settings.autostart_hint_windows: Start SD Sync Immich in the notification area when you sign in.
settings.autostart_unavailable: Not available for this copy of the app.
settings.autostart_translocated: Move SD Sync Immich to the Applications folder and open it from there to start it at login.
settings.auto_eject_hint: When everything is uploaded, the card is ejected so you can remove it right away.
settings.auto_format_hint: After uploading and checking that every photo and video is in Immich, the card will be formatted. If the camera then asks to recover its database, format the card in the camera.
settings.auto_format_needs_admin_hint: On Windows, formatting needs the app to run as administrator. Without that, the card is not formatted (it is still ejected if that is on).
settings.auto_format_confirm: All files on the card will be erased after checking that every photo and video is in Immich. This cannot be undone.
settings.notify_enabled_hint: Turn off to keep the app quiet. The app still shows the status in its window.
settings.notify_enabled_hint_mac: Turn off to keep the app quiet. The menu bar icon still shows the status.
settings.notify_enabled_hint_windows: Turn off to keep the app quiet. The icon in the notification area still shows the status.
settings.install_confirm: Install {version} now? The app will restart.
settings.installing: Installing… The app will restart when it’s done.
settings.update_manual: Update manually: download the new version from GitHub.
